text_block_list.text:
A joint fan meetup was being held with 
King Halo and her fellow generation peers—

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: King-onee-chan! Good luck in your race!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes, thank you. I'll definitely win, so 
watch me, okay?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...With eyes shining like that, how cute.
choice_data_list: I have to live up to their expectations.
I've got to live up to their expectations.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Naturally! I am top-class, so I would 
never do anything to crush a child's 
dreams!"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: King-chan, it's about time~.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hey, are you ready!?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Let's express our utmost gratitude to the 
fans who took the time to come all the way 
here~."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Preparation...? Gratitude...? What on 
earth was that about...?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Aren't the three of us scheduled to put on 
a mini live performance after this?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "...Ah!? A mini-live?!"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: That reaction... could it be...?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
King-chan had some urgent business, so she 
couldn't join us for lessons, but—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
But she said she'd do it on her own and 
that she'd be fine...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
T-That's not true!! It just slipped my 
mind for a second, that's all!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Nnnngh...! Forget the dance, I haven't 
even practiced the song! Not one bit...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, what should we do? We're in quite 
a pickle~.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
And we just finished talking about how we 
wouldn't crush everyone's dreams, too~!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: You are in trouble, yes! But worry not!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You have the world's strongest El Condor 
Pasa on your side! I will never, ever 
abandon you!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And so, let's learn it right now! With El 
teaching you, it'll be precise, perfect, 
and a grand finale!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Right now...?! Isn't that plan a bit too 
simplistic, or rather, we really don't 
have the time...
choice_data_list: Let's hear what Grass Wonder thinks, too.
Let's believe in El Condor Pasa.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaaat!? El's suggestion is off the 
table!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
They do say "two heads are better than 
three," after all... Grass-san, do you 
have any good ideas?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. There's a CD shop in this mall, 
after all...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
How about we change to a song where none 
of the three have any trouble with the 
singing or dancing~?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Changing the song...!? That's a fantastic 
idea!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... It's frustrating, but it's 
certainly way easier than learning it from 
scratch...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
King! Grass! Let's switch to a song that 
all three of us can sing and dance to!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Now that it's decided, I'll go buy 
the CD!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Grass-san, El Condor Pasa-san, I owe you 
both one!
And—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
The three of us will join forces to 
deliver the best stage possible—'Umapyoi 
Densetsu'!
(WAAAAAHHH~~~~!)

Thanks to their quick wit in changing the 
song, King Halo and the others were able 
to fire up the fans.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
A-All right, I understand...! El Condor 
Pasa-san, I'm counting on you.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: YES! Leave it to meee!!
And 15 minutes later—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: And now, for today's main event...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It's an exhibition match between El Condor 
Pasa and King Halo!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: A-Are we really doing this... for real...?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Thinking about it again, there's no way I 
can learn a new song starting now!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
So in place of the mini-live, it's time 
for... "Lucha Libre", YES!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'll take the hits so that even a beginner 
like King can safely hype up the venue!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Now, don't hold back, hit me with a move!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Even if you say that, I don't even know 
any special moves in the first place~!

text_block_list.name: All the Fans
text_block_list.text: Good luck to both of youuu!!

Somehow the mini-live transformed into a 
pro wrestling match, but the fans still 
cheered enthusiastically.
